messages:
Maria Gomez: CI red on main: `test_retry_backoff::ends_with_success` failing intermittently on linux-x86 runner. 3 failures in last 5 runs. Anyone seen this?

TJ Park: I saw a similar failure yesterday on arm. Can you paste the failure log?

Maria Gomez: Sure --- snippet from the test output:
```
thread 'test_retry_backoff::ends_with_success' panicked at 'assertion failed: elapsed >= expected', tests/retry_tests.rs:132
stack backtrace:
  0: core::panicking::panic_fmt
  1: runtime::retry::tests::ends_with_success
```

Anya Patel: Hm that assertion smells timing-related. Expected >= 200ms but observed ~198ms in one of the runs. Very close to the boundary.

Lee Chen: Also the test uses `std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50))` inside a tight loop. If CI worker scheduling jitter spikes, cumulative backoff could slip under the threshold.

Maria Gomez: Triggering a rerun now to get more samples. @ci-bot please rerun the job for commit abc123.

ci-bot: Rerun requested: build #3829 for commit abc123. Queued on linux-x86 pool.

devops-bot: FYI: if reruns exceed 5 failures, open a bisect and add the `flake` label per flaky test policy.

TJ Park: Quick options: 1) widen the timing assertion a bit, 2) mock the clock so test is deterministic, or 3) convert to an eventual assertion with more retries. I prefer mocking the timer.

Anya Patel: Agree on mock clock. We already use `tokio::time::pause()` in other suites. Switching this test to a mocked runtime will likely remove jitter.

Lee Chen: I can help with the runtime fixture change (use `#[tokio::test(flavor = "current_thread")]` + `tokio::time::pause()`). Should be a small fixture PR.

Maria Gomez: Thanks. I'll open a draft PR with two changes: (A) switch to paused tokio time, (B) add a CI-only short-term skip if the env `CI_SKIP_FLAKY` is set. Posting link when ready.

TJ Park: Good call to avoid touching production backoff logic. If bisect shows a regressing commit, we'll revisit algorithmically.

Maria Gomez: Bisect created: https://redwood.internal/bisect/3829 (pointing at range abc100..abc123). Lee, assigning you to review the fixture change.

Lee Chen: Taking it. Also note: we should add a short comment in the test referencing the CI noise and link to this thread for future context.

Anya Patel: +1. After PR lands let's run the flaky test job 10x in CI to validate.

ci-bot: Rerun #3829 completed: 1/10 runs failed on linux-x86. Flaky marker recommended.

Maria Gomez: OK marking as flaky in the tracker and pushing the draft PR now. Will follow up with the 10x run once PR is up.

TJ Park: Thanks team. If anything blocks the PR ping me.

devops-bot: Reminder: add `flake` label and a note about which shards were affected."
